proof:
Source: parent proof, Part B: the normalization preamble, steps 7–10 (B1 parametrization, B2/B2′ tangent planes and orientations of pieces, B3 the integer multiplicity current Φ_F closed by IMS, B4 identification F_#X = Φ_F via weak continuity of Jacobians; Simon Ch. 6, 3.3–3.9). The push-forward enters only through the hypothesis on S (the interface (6) of the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_pushforward_operators). Siblings used: dimred_mbl_dt_lp_covector_bounds ((L1)), covectorEuclideanNorm_gram_bounds ((L3): |α(v)| ≤ |α|√det Gram(v)), dpf_rectifiable_bilipschitz_pieces (B1), ptd_piece_image_approxTangent_ae (B2), dimred_mbl_dt_lp_jacobian_weak_continuity (B4 lemma). (VO), (MR), (IMC) = ((a) locality of approximate tangent spaces, (b) restriction to a Borel set, (c) differences, (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e. on the carrier) and (IMS) are the antecedents; (IMS) is used after discharging its own antecedents (VO), (MR), (IMC).

Notation. n := k + 1 ≥ 1, Hⁿ := μHE[n] (= Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ = Euclid n), e = (e_1, …, e_n) the standard basis of ℝⁿ. For linear A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^m, JA := √det(⟨Ae_a, Ae_b⟩)_{a,b} (= SimonGMT's normDet). For a Lipschitz map K : ℝⁿ → ℝ^m, DK(u) := fderiv ℝ K u (K is differentiable a.e., Rademacher), JK(u) := J(DK(u)), and for an n-form ω, (K^#ω)(e)(u) := ω(K(u))(DK(u)e_1, …, DK(u)e_n). |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α, ‖ω‖ := sup_y|ω(y)|. Lⁿ := volume.
 (AF) Area formula: if K is Lipschitz and injective on a Borel set E ⊆ ℝⁿ, then ∫_{K(E)} g dHⁿ = ∫_E g(K(u))JK(u) du for Borel g ≥ 0 (SimonGMT injective_area_formula_lipschitzOn, weighted_area_formula_lipschitzOn_fiberSum, whose fibre sums are single terms for an injective map; the within-derivative Jacobian equals JK(u) at a.e. u ∈ E). It extends to g ≥ 0 that is merely Hⁿ⌞K(E)-a.e. measurable (change g on a null set; by (NT) below the corresponding u-set is null), and then to real g with ∫_{K(E)}|g| dHⁿ < ∞ by splitting g = g⁺ − g⁻: ∫_{K(E)} g dHⁿ = ∫_E g(K(u))JK(u) du, both sides finite. This is how (AF) is applied below to integrands involving ξ, which is only a.e. strongly measurable.
 (NT) Null-set transfer: if K is Lipschitz, E Borel and κ|u − v| ≤ |K(u) − K(v)| for u, v ∈ E (κ > 0), then for Z ⊆ E, Lⁿ(Z) ≤ κ^{−n}Hⁿ(K(Z)) (the inverse K(E) → E is κ^{−1}-Lipschitz; Mathlib LipschitzOnWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le), and Hⁿ(K(Z)) ≤ Lip(K)ⁿLⁿ(Z). Hence a property holding Hⁿ-a.e. on K(E) holds at K(u) for Lⁿ-a.e. u ∈ E, the image of an Lⁿ-null subset of E is Hⁿ-null, and K pushes Lⁿ⌞E to a measure absolutely continuous with respect to Hⁿ⌞K(E) (and conversely). Also, by (AF), Lⁿ(Z) ≤ κ^{−n}∫_Z JK for Borel Z ⊆ E, so JK ≥ κⁿ Lⁿ-a.e. on E.

0. Linear algebra.
 (0a) |α(v_1, …, v_n)| ≤ |α|·√det(⟨v_a, v_b⟩) (sibling gram_bounds, first conjunct); in particular |(K^#ω)(e)(u)| ≤ |ω(K(u))|·JK(u).
 (0b) Frame identity. Let A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^m be linear and injective and τ an orthonormal basis of A(ℝⁿ). With C_{ab} := ⟨τ_a, Ae_b⟩, Ae_b = Σ_a C_{ab}τ_a, so α(Ae) = det(C)·α(τ) for every n-covector α (multilinearity and alternation), and (⟨Ae_a, Ae_b⟩) = CᵀC, so |det C| = JA > 0. Consequently, if ξ is a unit orientation of A(ℝⁿ) (ξ(α) = ±α(τ) for all α), then JA·ξ(α) = s·α(Ae) for all α with a sign s ∈ {1, −1} independent of α; and the n-vector α ↦ α(Ae)/JA equals ±(α ↦ α(τ)), i.e. it is a unit orientation of A(ℝⁿ) in the sense of IsUnitOrientationOf.
 (0c) If A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} is linear and ω an n-covector on ℝ^{N'}, then |ω∘A^{×n}| ≤ ‖A‖ⁿ|ω| (sibling covector_bounds, (L1)).
 (0d) If A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^m, B : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{m'} are linear, B injective and |Aw| ≤ Λ|Bw| for all w, then JA ≤ ΛⁿJB: AᵀA ≤ Λ²BᵀB as quadratic forms; with Q := BᵀB > 0, det(AᵀA) = det(Q)·det(Q^{−1/2}AᵀAQ^{−1/2}) and the middle matrix is symmetric with eigenvalues in [0, Λ²].
 (0e) The zero current of 𝒟_n(ℝ^m) is integer multiplicity: the IMRep with empty carrier, multiplicity 0 and orientation 0 satisfies all conditions vacuously (μHE[n] ∅ = 0, so the carrier is rectifiable by countablyRectifiable_of_measure_zero), and its action is an integral over ∅, i.e. 0.

1. Normalization (parent Part B preamble). Let R₀ = (M₀, θ, ξ) represent X. E := spt X is closed, hence Borel. By (IMC)(b) (U = ℝ^N open) there are a current A and an IMRep R with R.Represents A, carrier M := M₀ ∩ E, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ. Hⁿ(M₀ ∖ E) = 0: by (MR) for X, R₀ and the open set W := ℝ^N ∖ E, ∫_{M₀∖E} θ dHⁿ = R₀.measure(W) = M_W(X), and M_W(X) = 0 because every admissible form with tsupport ⊆ W is disjoint from spt X, hence killed by (VO); as θ ≥ 1 on M₀, Hⁿ(M₀ ∖ E) = 0. Therefore μHE[n].restrict M₀ = μHE[n].restrict M, so A(ω) = R.action(ω) = R₀.action(ω) = X(ω) for all ω, i.e. R represents X. So X = τ(M, θ, ξ) with M ⊆ spt X Borel and countably n-rectifiable, ∫_M θ dHⁿ = R.measure(ℝ^N) = M(X) < ∞ ((MR) with W = ℝ^N), Hⁿ(M) ≤ M(X) (θ ≥ 1), X(η) = ∫_M θ·ξ(η) dHⁿ for every test form η, and |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M ((IMC)(d)).

2. B1 (sibling dpf_rectifiable_bilipschitz_pieces applied to M). There are Lipschitz G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N (constants L_i), Borel A_i ⊆ ℝⁿ and m_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) with: m_i|u − v| ≤ |G_i(u) − G_i(v)| on A_i; G_i differentiable with DG_i(u) injective at every u ∈ A_i; G_i(A_i) Borel, ⊆ M, pairwise disjoint; Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_i G_i(A_i)) = 0. Put θ_i := θ∘G_i (Borel, ≥ 1 on A_i). By (AF) and disjointness, Σ_i ∫_{A_i} θ_i JG_i du = Σ_i ∫_{G_i(A_i)} θ dHⁿ = ∫_M θ dHⁿ = M(X); by (NT), JG_i ≥ m_iⁿ a.e. on A_i, so ∫_{A_i} θ_i du ≤ m_i^{−n}∫_{G_i(A_i)} θ dHⁿ < ∞.

3. B2′ (tangent planes and orientation on the pieces). Claim: for Lⁿ-a.e. u ∈ A_i, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (G_i(u)) V_i(u), V_i(u) := DG_i(u)(ℝⁿ), and there is s_i(u) ∈ {1, −1} with JG_i(u)·ξ(G_i(u))(α) = s_i(u)·α(DG_i(u)e) for all n-covectors α. Proof: by the sibling ptd_piece_image_approxTangent_ae (G_i, A_i, L_i, m_i), for a.e. u ∈ A_i the set G_i(A_i) has approximate tangent space V_i(u) at G_i(u). By (IMC)(a) (U = ℝ^N; G_i(A_i) ⊆ M both Borel; Hⁿ(M ∩ K) ≤ Hⁿ(M) < ∞), for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ G_i(A_i) the approximate tangent spaces of G_i(A_i) and of M at x coincide; by (NT) this holds at x = G_i(u) for a.e. u ∈ A_i. The IMRep property (orients) gives, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, a plane Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q; by (NT) this holds at x = G_i(u) for a.e. u ∈ A_i, and by uniqueness (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique) Q = V_i(u). Then (0b) with A = DG_i(u) gives the sign s_i(u). Put s_i(u) := 1 at the remaining (null) points of A_i. Measurability: on the good set, s_i(u) = ξ(G_i(u))(γ_u)/JG_i(u), where γ_u(w) := det(⟨DG_i(u)e_a, w_b⟩)_{a,b} is an n-covector depending Borel-measurably on u with γ_u(DG_i(u)e) = JG_i(u)²; since ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M and G_i pushes Lⁿ⌞A_i to a measure ≪ Hⁿ⌞M (NT), u ↦ ξ(G_i(u)) is a.e. strongly measurable for Lⁿ⌞A_i, so s_i is Lⁿ⌞A_i-a.e. measurable. Hence w_i := θ_i s_i 1_{A_i} ∈ L¹(ℝⁿ) (step 2).

4. Setup. H_i := F∘G_i is ΛL_i-Lipschitz. At a.e. u ∈ A_i, H_i is differentiable (Rademacher) and |DH_i(u)w| = lim_{t↓0}|F(G_i(u + tw)) − F(G_i(u))|/t ≤ Λ|DG_i(u)w|, so JH_i(u) ≤ ΛⁿJG_i(u) by (0d). For ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^{N'}) define Φ(ω) := Σ_i ∫_{A_i} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du. By (0a), |(H_i^#ω)(e)| ≤ ‖ω‖JH_i ≤ Λⁿ‖ω‖JG_i a.e. on A_i, so the series converges absolutely and |Φ(ω)| ≤ ΛⁿM(X)‖ω‖.

5. B3 (Φ is the action of an integer multiplicity current Ŝ).
 (a) A_i^+ := {u ∈ A_i : H_i differentiable at u, DH_i(u) injective} is Borel (Mathlib measurableSet_of_differentiableAt, measurable_fderiv; non-injectivity is the vanishing of the continuous function A ↦ det(AᵀA)). At points of A_i ∖ A_i^+ where H_i is differentiable, (H_i^#ω)(e) = 0 (the vectors DH_i(u)e_a are dependent), and the non-differentiability points are null; so Φ(ω) = Σ_i ∫_{A_i^+} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du. Partition A_i^+ into bi-Lipschitz pieces: for an injective linear A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{N'} choose K_A > 0 with |Aw| ≥ |w|/K_A for all w (Mathlib LinearMap.exists_antilipschitzWith) and put r(A) := 1/(2K_A); put r(A) := 1 if A is not injective (so r is ℝ≥0-valued and never 0). H_i has derivative DH_i(u) at every u ∈ A_i^+, so Mathlib exists_partition_approximatesLinearOn_of_hasFDerivWithinAt (f = H_i, s = A_i^+, f' = DH_i, r) gives pairwise disjoint Borel sets t_l with A_i^+ ⊆ ⋃_l t_l and linear maps B_l with |H_i(u) − H_i(v) − B_l(u − v)| ≤ r(B_l)|u − v| for u, v ∈ A_i^+ ∩ t_l and, if A_i^+ ≠ ∅, B_l = DH_i(y_l) for some y_l ∈ A_i^+ (so B_l is injective). Put A_{il} := A_i^+ ∩ t_l (Borel, pairwise disjoint, union A_i^+) and κ_{il} := (2K_{B_l})^{−1}; then |H_i(u) − H_i(v)| ≥ |B_l(u − v)| − r(B_l)|u − v| ≥ κ_{il}|u − v| for u, v ∈ A_{il}; in particular H_i is injective on A_{il}.
 (b) For each (i, l) let N_{il} := H_i(A_{il}) (Borel by Lusin–Souslin, Mathlib MeasurableSet.image_of_continuousOn_injOn), h_{il} := (H_i|A_{il})^{−1} : N_{il} → A_{il}, and define R_{il}: carrier N_{il}; multiplicity μ_{il}(y) := θ_i(h_{il}(y)) for y ∈ N_{il} and 0 otherwise; orientation ζ_{il}(y) := s_i(h_{il}(y))·(α ↦ α(DH_i(h_{il}y)e)/JH_i(h_{il}y)) for y ∈ N_{il} and 0 otherwise. R_{il} is an IMRep in U = ℝ^{N'}: the carrier is Borel and countably n-rectifiable (contained in the range of the Lipschitz H_i; SimonGMT countablyRectifiable_range, CountablyRectifiable.mono); the multiplicity is ℕ-valued, Borel ({y ∈ N_{il} : μ_{il}(y) = m} = H_i({u ∈ A_{il} : θ_i(u) = m}) is Borel by Lusin–Souslin) and ≥ 1 on N_{il}; it is integrable: ∫_{N_{il}} μ_{il} dHⁿ = ∫_{A_{il}} θ_i JH_i du ≤ Λⁿ∫_{A_i} θ_i JG_i du < ∞ ((AF) for H_i on A_{il}); the orientation is a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞N_{il} (h_{il} pushes Hⁿ⌞N_{il} to a measure ≪ Lⁿ⌞A_{il} by (NT), and s_i, DH_i, JH_i are a.e. measurable on A_{il}); and it orients: by the sibling ptd_piece_image_approxTangent_ae (H_i, A_{il}, ΛL_i, κ_{il}; H_i is differentiable with injective derivative on A_{il} ⊆ A_i^+), for a.e. u ∈ A_{il} the set N_{il} has approximate tangent space DH_i(u)(ℝⁿ) at H_i(u), and by (0b) ζ_{il}(H_i(u)) = ±(α ↦ α(τ)) for an orthonormal basis τ of that plane, i.e. IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ_{il}(H_i u)) (DH_i(u)(ℝⁿ)); the exceptional u form an Lⁿ-null set with Hⁿ-null image (NT).
 (c) By (IMC)(b) (U = E = ℝ^{N'}) there are a current Φ_{il} ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{N'}) and an IMRep with the carrier, multiplicity and orientation of R_{il} representing it; so Φ_{il} is integer multiplicity and, by (AF) (the integrand is bounded by μ_{il}‖ω‖ by (0a), hence integrable), Φ_{il}(ω) = ∫_{N_{il}} μ_{il}ζ_{il}(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_{A_{il}} θ_i s_i [ω(H_i(u))(DH_i(u)e)/JH_i(u)]·JH_i(u) du = ∫_{A_{il}} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du. By (MR), M(Φ_{il}) = R_{il}.measure(ℝ^{N'}) = ∫_{A_{il}} θ_i JH_i du, so Σ_{i,l} M(Φ_{il}) ≤ ΛⁿM(X) < ∞.
 (d) Enumerate the pairs (i, l) by m ∈ ℕ and put W_m := Φ_{i_m l_m}, padding with zero currents (integer multiplicity by (0e)) if there are finitely many. Σ_m M(W_m) < ∞, so (IMS) (with P := N' and this k) gives an integer multiplicity Ŝ ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}) with HasSum (m ↦ W_m(ω)) (Ŝ(ω)) for every ω. The double series Σ_i Σ_l ∫_{A_{il}} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du converges absolutely (bound ‖ω‖∫_{A_{il}} θ_iJH_i), so it may be reordered: Ŝ(ω) = Σ_i ∫_{A_i^+} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du = Φ(ω).

6. B4 (identification: S = Φ). Let F_j and, for a fixed ω, η_j be as in the hypothesis: F_j is C^∞ and Λ-Lipschitz (so ‖DF_j‖ ≤ Λ), F_j → F uniformly, η_j = F_j^#ω on an open W_j ⊇ spt X, and X(η_j) → S(ω). By step 1 and M ⊆ spt X ⊆ W_j, X(η_j) = ∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(ω(F_j(x))∘DF_j(x)^{×n}) dHⁿ(x). The integrand is bounded by θ·Λⁿ‖ω‖ a.e. ((IMC)(d), (0c)), hence integrable; splitting M into the disjoint G_i(A_i) and a null set and applying (AF) for G_i on A_i, step 3 (with α := ω(F_j(G_i u))∘DF_j(G_i u)^{×n}) and the chain rule DH_{ij}(u) = DF_j(G_i(u))∘DG_i(u) for H_{ij} := F_j∘G_i at every u ∈ A_i:
 X(η_j) = Σ_i ∫_{A_i} θ_i(u)JG_i(u)ξ(G_i(u))(ω(F_j(G_i u))∘DF_j(G_i u)^{×n}) du = Σ_i ∫_{A_i} θ_i s_i (H_{ij}^#ω)(e) du = Σ_i ∫ w_i·ω(H_{ij}(u))(DH_{ij}(u)e) du.
 For fixed i, the maps H_{ij} (j ∈ ℕ) and H_i are ΛL_i-Lipschitz, H_{ij} → H_i uniformly (|F_j∘G_i − F∘G_i| ≤ sup|F_j − F|), w_i ∈ L¹(ℝⁿ) (step 3), and ω is continuous with compact support; so the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_jacobian_weak_continuity gives ∫ w_i·ω(H_{ij})(DH_{ij}e) → ∫ w_i·ω(H_i)(DH_ie) = ∫_{A_i} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du as j → ∞. The i-th term is bounded in absolute value by Λⁿ‖ω‖∫_{A_i} θ_i JG_i du (by the first expression and (0c), |ξ| ≤ |·|), which is summable in i with sum ΛⁿM(X)‖ω‖. By dominated convergence for series (Mathlib tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence), X(η_j) → Σ_i ∫_{A_i} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e) du = Φ(ω).

7. Conclusion. For every ω, S(ω) = lim_j X(η_j) = Φ(ω) = Ŝ(ω) (uniqueness of limits, steps 5 and 6), so S = Ŝ (GeometricCurrentOn.ext), and S is integer multiplicity. ∎
key_steps: Linear algebra (0a)–(0e): Gram bound, frame identity, (L1), determinant monotonicity, zero current is integer multiplicity.
Normalize X = τ(M, θ, ξ) with M ⊆ spt X by (IMC)(b), (MR), (VO); ∫_M θ = M(X).
Pieces G_i, A_i (sibling B1); tangent planes and signs s_i on the pieces via the sibling B2, (IMC)(a), uniqueness and the frame identity (B2′).

Φ(ω) := Σ_i ∫_{A_i} θ_i s_i (H_i^#ω)(e), H_i = F∘G_i; bi-Lipschitz pieces A_il of {DH_i injective} give IMReps on N_il = H_i(A_il), currents Φ_il via (IMC)(b), and (IMS) sums them to an integer multiplicity Ŝ = Φ.
X(η_j) = Σ_i ∫ θ_i s_i (H_ij^#ω)(e) → Φ(ω) by the sibling weak-continuity lemma and dominated convergence for series; S = Ŝ.
